LIQUID media session fixture

Publishes a Windows media session with known metadata, so the GSMTC bridge can be verified against values chosen in advance rather than against whatever happens to be playing.

Press Play with the mouse or keyboard. Chromium only hands a media session to Windows once playback has been started by a genuine user gesture. Launching with --autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required makes the audio play, but the session stays inactive and never reaches GSMTC, so this fixture cannot be driven fully unattended — a real click is required.
Capabilities are deliberately asymmetric. This page registers handlers for play, pause, nexttrack and previoustrack, but not seekto. A correct reader must therefore report seek as unsupported. If LIQUID shows seeking as available, it is assuming capabilities instead of reading them.
